read.en: Bloom Energy fell 1.4% on Nov 18 to $170.98, trading $167.36–180.47 on light volume (0.61x the 20-day average). It is below the falling 5-day ($183.1), 10-day ($184.5), 30-day ($213.5) and 100-day ($232.7) and the rising 200-day ($223.8). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 17, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($210.72), and RSI is 38.7.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 11月18日下跌 1.4%，收于 $170.98，盘中区间 $167.36–180.47，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.61 倍）。股价位于下行的 5 日（$183.1）、10 日（$184.5）、30 日（$213.5）和 100 日均线（$232.7）以及上行的 200 日均线（$223.8）下方。MACD 自 11月17日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$210.72），RSI 为 38.7。

read.en: The close slipped further below $173.5, and the $167.36 low dipped just under the Nov 5 close ($167.52) before recovering. Resistance is $173.5–173.9 (Nov 17 close, Nov 16 low), then $180.5–183.2 (Nov 18 and 16 highs, 5-day) and $184.5–185.4 (10-day, Nov 10 close). Support is $167.4–168.8, then $162.9 (Nov 17 low) and $156 (Nov 5 low). A close above $173.9 would target $180.5–183; below $167.4, $162.9.
